prompt.text:
Implement an immutable in-memory catalog transformation in `Solution.java`. Define a public static final immutable `Product` class with constructor `Product(int id, String name, String category, long priceCents)` and getters. IDs must be positive, names and categories must be non-null and non-blank, and prices must be non-negative; otherwise the constructor throws `IllegalArgumentException`. Expose `public static List<Product> create(List<Product> catalog, Product product)`, `read(List<Product> catalog, int id)`, `update(List<Product> catalog, Product replacement)`, and `delete(List<Product> catalog, int id)`. `create`, `update`, and `delete` return unmodifiable new lists sorted by ascending ID and never mutate or alias the input list. `read` returns the matching product or throws `NoSuchElementException`. Duplicate creation throws `IllegalStateException`; update or delete of a missing ID throws `NoSuchElementException`. Null lists, products, or list elements throw `NullPointerException`. An empty catalog is valid. Use only the Java standard library.
